class.name: IfcDistributionPort
class.brief_description: A distribution port is an inlet or outlet of a product through which a particular substance may flow. Distribution ports are used for passage of solid, liquid, or gas substances, as well as electricity for power or communications. members.member: Enumeration that identifies if this port is a Sink (inlet), a Source (outlet) or both a SinkAndSource. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset.

Enumeration that identifies the system type. If a system type is defined, the port may only be connected to other ports having the same system type. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset. Only in IFC4 and IFC4X3_ADD2 files: in others it reads as null and can't be set.
